title: finding(docs): three live-sounding populations in registerCatalogBlocks.ts's header derive from nothing — `all 181 docs pages` (184 today), `556/556 static pages`, `440 thumbnail frames` — and it is the likely provenance of objectui#9004's figure
body:
Found while implementing objectui#9004, which removed `556-page docs build` from `content/docs/guide/ci-cd-pipeline.md` and from the eager-closure gate's header. ⛔ Not fixed there: it is a different file, a different corpus and a different claim, and it needs its own decision.

## The instance

The header docblock of `apps/site/app/components/registerCatalogBlocks.ts` is the repo's only hand-taken measurement of the docs route. It is genuinely a record of one build — the before/after chunk figures are a past measurement and cannot drift. But three sentences in the same block are written as **live** claims about today's tree, and nothing derives any of them:

| stated | where it reads as live |
|---|---|
| `all 181 docs pages` | "that route is shared by all 181 docs pages, not just the gallery" |
| `556/556 static pages` | "The prerender is unaffected: the build still emits 556/556 static pages" |
| `all 440 thumbnail frames` | "the gallery's own HTML still carries all 440 thumbnail frames" |

⇒ `181` is already false: the docs collection `apps/site/source.config.ts` declares holds **184** git-tracked `.md`/`.mdx` files on `d8b4739d4`, of which 144 are `.mdx` — which is what the eager-closure gate's own `gauge:` line reports. objectui#8629 removed the same `181 docs pages` wording from the docs page; this copy of it survived because it lives outside `content/docs/**`.

## ⭐ Why this one is worth a card and not just a numeral fix

⭐ This header is the most likely **provenance** of the figure objectui#9004 just removed. `556/556 static pages` is a Next prerender total taken once from a build on disk; `a 556-page docs build in CI` — the sentence objectui#9004 removed from two places — reads as that same figure transplanted into a claim about the docs collection, which it was never a count of. A hand-taken number that nothing derives does not only go stale; it migrates, and it arrives in the new sentence with the authority of a measurement.

## What this card has to decide

1. Whether the block declares the commit it was measured on, the way the four correct sentences on `content/docs/guide/ci-cd-pipeline.md` do. That is the remedy objectui#7965/objectui#8629 settled on for a past measurement worth keeping: state what was measured and when, so it stops reading as a live fact.
2. Whether the three live-sounding sentences keep their numbers at all, or point at the derivations (`source.config.ts`'s collection directory and the eager-closure gate's `gauge:` line for the docs-page population; the prerender's own output for the static-page total).
3. Whether objectui#7448's pin family should reach this file. Every carrier of that family today reads either a workflow header or a named section of a docs page — a source file's docblock is outside all of them, which is exactly how this copy outlived the docs-page copy objectui#8629 removed.

## Scope note

⛔ Nothing here is a numeral to refresh. Correcting `181` to `184` reproduces the defect on a one-month timer, which is the ruling objectui#7448, objectui#7825, objectui#7965 and objectui#8629 have each recorded after doing exactly that.

Filed by the objectui#9004 developer seat, unassigned, for triage.
